notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Things that are hopefully fixed, please let me know if you still experience any of these things.
-Opening cutscene bird glitch
-Optional boss fight can now be exited, though probably not with a prepatch save
-Controls on first play and custom controls glitches fixed (I think) but still default controls on main menu
-Fork is more easily lit now
-Big spike ball glitch fix
-Linux version not downloading should be fixed

Again, if any of this is still not working for you after you update and start a new save, let me know. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
-New "DEATHLESS" Achievement! Good luck!
-Lots of bug fixes
-Lots of small graphical updates
-Lots of controls fixes
-Some slight stage layout changes
-A couple of music fixes
-A couple of optimizations

-Significantly reduced final boss difficulty
-Made the arcade sign opening more forgiving
-Fixed a snow crow theft bug
-Fixed the optional boss early spike death bug
-Fixed a checkpoint issue above the locked room
-Added a very important person to the credits
-Updated the speedrun achievement from 25 mins to 30 mins
-Fixed some steam overlay bugs

notes.title: 0.7.3 Patch
notes.notes:
-Working toward steam deck support
-Back to (permanent?) nwjs instead of webview2
-Achievement fixes for ones that didn't trigger
-Achievement popups now work!
-Linux support in transition
-Save files may be erased, hopefully for the first and last time (sorry!)
-Fixed some spawn issues
-Spinning fork now damages final boss
-Fixed some audio issues
-Fixed issue with pumpkin 10
-Behind the scenes programming fixes

-More updates to come and thanks for the support and patience!
